$comment: Descriptive, derived from the types the bounded parser reads; the parser is the only authority on validity. Where the parser reads two versions of a document with one type, this schema admits what that type admits, including members the later version adds. Byte, depth and count bounds are recorded in x-rustev-parse-limits (a string length here counts characters, the parser counts bytes), and rules applied when a plan is compiled are stated in field descriptions, not enforced here.

DecisionPayload.description:
A judged decision's reusable work (spec 044, 3.6.4). It holds no
judgment to serve: the core recomputes every served judgment (3.6.3).

judgment.description: The record digest of the source decision's judgment.

requests.description: Each request outside the refresh closure, by step then instance.

run_record.description: The record digest of the source decision's run record.

volatile.description:
The source decision's snapshot entries of its volatile inputs, as
supplied, for a failed refresh (3.6.5).

grade.description:
Snapshot 2: the grade the supplier observed; it can lower a grade,
never raise it (spec 032, 3.3.5).

producer.description: Host-declared model producer, retained as evidence, never authorization.

source.description: Which source supplied it; recorded, never trusted as authority.

value.description: Decoded strictly against the input's declared type.

EntryBody.description: Everything an entry holds besides its integrity digest.

created.description:
The evaluation time of the decision that wrote the entry; expiry
is measured from it (3.4.3).

evidence.description: The digest of the run record whose attempt produced the payload.

generations.description: The store's generations captured before the work began.

key_id.description: The key's digest, under which the store keeps the entry.

key_material.description: The complete canonical key material, lowercase hexadecimal.

runtime_version.description: The runtime version that wrote the entry.

EntryKind.description:
A request-level entry, or a decision-result cache entry (3.6.4); the
payload's variant is the kind's.

FieldLogprobs.description: Backend option log-probabilities; field eligibility is checked by the core.

Grade.description:
The closed, ordered evidence grade. The derived order runs weakest to
strongest, so `min` and `max` are the grade order of spec 032, 3.2.1.

oneOf.description:
A label from a source declared unreliable for that field, or a
constructed key not yet corroborated.
A computed or crawled approximation that never was authoritative.
Was authoritative at its as-of time and has not been revalidated.
Live, attested by the system that owns the fact.

ProvenanceClass.description: The closed set of provenance classes (spec 002, 3.7.1).

RankingScores.description: Optional ranking scores with an explicit wire sentinel (spec 039, 3.5.2).

RawOutput.description: What a backend returned, before validation.

RequestPayload.description:
A validated raw output and where it came from. Its derivation follows
from the plan, which the key names; its lineage is the source attempt
and the entry's `evidence`.

target.description: The index of the target that answered: the primary, or a fallback.

ReusedRequestPayload.description:
A request outside the refresh closure: its 017 key, the validated
output of target 0 and the attempt that produced it. As for a request
payload, its derivation follows from the plan the entry's key names,
and its lineage is the source attempt and the payload's `run_record`.

key_material.description:
The request's complete canonical key material, lowercase
hexadecimal.

ScreenUnits.description: A screener's reported text units, distinct from runtime computed charges.

TextValue.description: A generated field before plan-dependent validation (spec 037, 3.7).

integrity.description: Over the record canonical bytes of `entry`, tagged with the schema.
